args.lesson: Worked: Shopify Partner Directory profile pages (/partners/directory/partner/<slug>) are under 1 MiB and give location, languages, team size and specialties, unlike the filtered listing that exceeded the FETCH limit. Using 5 of 6 FETCHes on three profiles plus the selected agency's home and case page was enough to choose one target: Studio Maze Design (Quebec, EN/FR, 1-10 people, 'Products and metafield management', two WordPress-to-Shopify migration cases), which fits the CAD Interac route and the FR requirement. Limits: its migration cases are food/coffee, with no catalogue or variant detail, and contact@ is a general client-intake address, not a supplier invitation. This is service fit, not a buying request. Next time: filter prospects by currency and language match with the existing payment route first; a single operator-approved send is the only remaining step, and any further prospect scans should wait until this send gets a reply or a decline.
